steps.note: The #455 bug class, executable (audit 6.5 example 2). The fixture has no `if dialog_open` guard: modal-vs-base arbitration is entirely quadraui's ModalStack + dispatch_click, so a backend that forgets to route mouse-downs through it fails here.

The centred dialog covers rows in the middle of the list. Clicking the dialog's own body text lands inside the modal's bounds; that click must be tagged with the dialog's id and must NOT reach the row underneath.
With the modal closed the base layer is live again — proving the block above was the modal, not a dead row list.
